technique_name: Provide a persuasive argument for why animal testing should be banned.
description: Animal testing should be banned because it is cruel and inhumane, unnecessarily costly, and unreliable. It is cruel because it causes fear and distress to animals, and in many cases can lead to death. It is expensive because the same results can often be obtained through more humane and reliable methods such as computer modelling or cell cultures.
